subject_pin.candidate_repin_policy: This profile declares NO unmerged candidate source: candidate_commit is pinned equal to main_commit and candidate_source_path is the owned tree itself, so there is nothing to re-pin at publication. subject_pin is all-or-nothing in repository-control-plane-profile/v1, which is why all six keys are present. The github-portfolio-control publish-time re-pin obligation is NOT inherited here. If a future revision ever sources bytes from an unmerged commit, that revision must re-introduce a real candidate and its own re-pin policy.
